title: Create Student Table
MongoDB Find Students with High Marks
Python Fibonacci Series
content:
def fibonacci(n):
    a, b = 0, 1
    series = []
    for _ in range(n):
        series.append(a)
        a, b = b, a + b
    return series

print('Fibonacci (10 terms):', fibonacci(10))

title: SQL SELECT with JOIN
content:
-- INNER JOIN example
SELECT s.name, s.marks, c.course_name
FROM students s
INNER JOIN enrollments e ON s.id = e.student_id
INNER JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.id
WHERE s.marks > 75
ORDER BY s.marks DESC;
